SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MERCER COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001827
DOCKET NO. DJ04885525
PLAINTIFF – SNCO CAP LLC
DEFENDANT- TUNIESA L. SIMMONS-DOZIER
By virtue of a Writ of Execution in the above stated action to me directed and delivered, I shall expose for sale at public venue and sell to the highest bidder on:
Wednesday THE 23rd DAY OF September 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of SCOTCH PLAINS, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
180 WATCHUNG TERRACE SCOTCH PLAINS, NJ 07076
TAX LOT AND BLOCK NUMBERS: Lot: 7; Block: 3901
DIMENSIONS: Approximately 100 feet × 70 feet (0.160 acres)
UPSET PRICE: $100.00
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT DUE: $1,386,753.21
OCCUPANCY STATUS: Likely owner-occupied
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Watchung Terrace, at a point distant
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
PRIOR LIENS: The property is being sold subject to a prior first mortgage held by Rocket Mortgage, LLC (f/k/a Quicken Loans, LLC), recorded November 16, 2017 in the Office of the County Clerk/Register of Union County in Mortgage Book 14365, Page 461, as Instrument No. 649332, in the approximate payoff amount of $225,692.32 as of August 6, 2026, which mortgage lien is superior to Plaintiffs judgment lien and is not being extinguished by this sale. The property is further sold subject to any unpaid real estate taxes, sewer and water charges constituting municipal liens, which taxes and liens are not being extinguished by this sale. As of a tax and assessment search dated June 29, 2026, the following amounts remain to become due: a sewer charge of $325.00 due September 1, 2026; third-quarter 2026 real estate taxes due August 1, 2026; and fourth-quarter 2026 real estate taxes due November 1, 2026. The property is further being sold subject to restrictions and easements of record which are unknown to the Sheriff and such state of facts as an accurate survey, title search, and physical inspection of the premises would disclose. The property is being sold subject to the rights of occupants or tenants, if any. The property is being sold subject to state and municipal ordinances, statutes and regulations, including zoning ordinances, and federal laws and regulations that may apply.
SURPLUS MONEY: This is a judgment execution sale conducted pursuant to a Writ of Execution and N.J.S.A. 2A: 17- 1 et seq. If, after the sale and satisfaction of the judgment, together with costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the Sheriff shall pay any such surplus to the Clerk of the Superior Court within thirty (30) days after the sale as directed by the Writ of Execution, and the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund. Any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rule 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office. Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon. If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $1,386,753.21 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: August 28, 2026
ATTORNEY FOR THE PLAINTIFF
JAMES M. SULLIVAN
SEYFARTH SHAW LLP
620 EIGHTH AVENUE
32ND FLOOR
NEW YORK, NY 10018
(212) 218-5500
